title.ja: 大不了(Take it Easy)コンセプトフィルム

transcript.text: Look, the Earth is full of oceans But someone has to stir the waves
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ルック・ジ・アース・イズ・フル・オブ・オーシャンズ・バット・サムワン・ハズ・トゥ・スティア・ザ・ウェイブス
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Look , the Earth is full of oceans But someone has to stir the waves

translations.ja: 見てよ、地球は海でいっぱいだ。でも誰かが波をかき混ぜなきゃいけない
translations.en: Look, the Earth is full of oceans But someone has to stir the waves
translations.ko: 봐요, 지구는 바다로 가득하지만 누군가는 파도를 일으켜야죠
translations.zh-TW: 看吧，地球上滿是海洋，但總得有人去攪動波浪
translations.id: Dengar, Bumi ini penuh dengan samudra Namun seseorang harus mengaduk ombaknya
translations.pt: Olha, a Terra está cheia de oceanos, mas alguém tem que agitar as ondas

transcript.text: At worst, the waves slap me in the face So what? I’ll high-five it back

translations.zh-TW: 大不了，浪花扇我一巴掌，那又怎樣？我拍手擊掌回敬它
translations.id: Paling buruk, ombak itu menampar mukaku Lalu kenapa? Aku akan balas menepuknya
